name: Accessory Design
overview: Accessory design is a dynamic and creative field that revolves around the creation of fashion accessories including jewelry, handbags, hats, belts, and scarves. Professionals combine artistic skills, creativity, and technical knowledge to develop unique designs while staying current with fashion trends and manufacturing techniques. The field requires understanding of materials, production processes, and market demands.

topJobs.description: Develop accessories that enhance and complete clothing lines for fashion brands.
Design and produce accessories for distribution to retail stores and online platforms.
Create unique necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and rings using precious metals and gemstones.
Work independently offering design services to multiple clients with creative freedom.
topJobs.indiaSalary: Varies greatly; project-based or hourly/daily rates; moderate to high earnings possible

Parsons School of Design, The New School (United States)
careerLadder: High school focus on art, design, and fashion subjects
Elementary and Intermediate certificates (up to 10th grade)
Engage in creative activities, design competitions, exhibitions, and workshops
